# VIYLSA

> VIYLSA builds 360° virtual tours for venues in Pakistan. Every tour ships with
> a built-in AI guide that answers visitors in English and Urdu from documents the
> venue approves, plus visitor analytics and lead capture. Based in Islamabad and
> Rawalpindi.

Pronounced "VY-el-sa". VIYLSA is a company name, not a misspelling of another word.

## What VIYLSA does

- 360° panoramic photography of a venue, usually captured in a single afternoon
  without the venue closing.
- An AI guide trained only on documents the venue supplies (floor plan, FAQ,
  pricing, brochures). It answers in English and Urdu, switchable mid-conversation,
  and hands the visitor to human contact details rather than guessing when unsure.
- Visitor analytics: which spaces were opened, how long visitors stayed, what they
  asked the guide, and the enquiries it captured.
- Hosting, a shareable link that works on WhatsApp and email, and a one-line embed
  for the venue's own site.

Venues served: universities and campuses, hotels and guest houses, hospitals and
clinics, real estate and offices, showrooms and retail, event halls and restaurants.
